title: Python for Data Analysis
tagline: Go from zero Python to answering real business questions with pandas.
description: Spreadsheets break down when the data gets messy, the questions repeat every month, or someone asks how you got that number. This course teaches you Python and pandas from the first line of code, using the real tables of Cartwheel, an online store: orders, products, customers, returns and a deliberately messy export like the ones that land in your inbox.

You learn the habits working analysts rely on: inspect data before you trust it, clean it with code you can rerun, check every join, and explain a number in plain words. The course ends with a full case study, why Cartwheel's Q4 2025 revenue jumped, and a short guide to making your analysis reproducible.
audience: Career switchers and spreadsheet users who want to analyse data with Python, starting from zero programming experience.
prerequisites: None. Comfort with a spreadsheet (sums, filters, pivot tables) helps but is not required.
learnItems: Write the core Python an analyst needs: types, lists, dicts, functions
Load, inspect and select data with pandas DataFrames
Clean missing values, text, money strings, dates and duplicates
Summarise and join tables with groupby, merge and pivot_table
Analyse trends over time with resample and the dt accessor
Answer a business question end to end and make it reproducible
